page: Microsoft Azure E160ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. It features 160 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 80 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The server is equipped with 1280.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 9449 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

In benchmark evaluations, the E160ads_v7 demonstrates top-tier performance across multiple domains. Its multi-core CPU performance registers at 287659.31 in stress-ng, while single-core performance reaches 3777.59. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only small block cached speeds at 14497.71 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 210.18 GB/sec. Database operations are strong, with Redis SET operations achieving 202.43 million operations per second and Passmark database operations scoring 41416.44.

While the server excels in prompt processing for medium LLM models at 371.42 tokens per second, its text generation speed for small models is average at 263.24 tokens per second, reflecting a potential bottleneck in sequential generation tasks without dedicated GPU acceleration. Given its high resource density, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, big data analytics, and heavy multi-threaded decompression tasks.
